description_audit.scope: Retained first measured pair, all 199 changed RSS feeds. HTML token comparison ignores only participating URL attribute values and outer description whitespace. Python urllib independently checks changed actual URL attributes; repository fixtures cover additional WHATWG/data/srcset cases.

cross_pair_xml_variation.scope: OLD pair 2 differs by one byte in four RSS files from the other OLD runs; all non-XML pair comparisons and RSS metadata/structure checks passed. No unmeasured rebuild was added to investigate this.

limits: A single local snapshot and Hugo binary; not a general ranking or CI prediction.
Concurrent parent browser tests and other host activity are not controlled; wall time includes scheduling and I/O contention.
Hugo process CPU excludes browser CPU, but CPU/cache contention can still affect the amount of CPU needed.
Warm disk/resource caches; OS page cache is not flushed. Counterbalancing limits, but does not eliminate, order effects.
The old implementation has known relative-URI defects; this comparison is a cost measurement, not a recommendation to restore it.

OLD pair 2 has a one-byte difference in four RSS outputs versus the other OLD pairs. All non-XML outputs still match, and RSS structures outside item description bodies still match their paired CURRENT builds. The retained first-pair XML allows independent description auditing; other pairs retain complete byte manifests.
